(the Company) issued a press release announcing positive topline clinical trial results across its oral small molecule amylin and GLP-1 programs for chronic weight management, including Phase 1/2a single ascending dose (SAD) results for ACCG-2671 (oral small molecule amylin receptor agonist) and 72-week results from the ACCESS open-label extension (OLE) study of aleniglipron (oral small molecule selective GLP-1 receptor agonist).

ACCG-2671 (Oral Small Molecule DACRA): Phase 1 SAD Topline Clinical Trial Results On September 8, 2026, the Company reported positive topline data for ACCG-2671, an oral, non-peptide, small molecule dual amylin and calcitonin receptor agonist (DACRA), from the SAD portion of the Phase 1/2a clinical trial.
Topline data for the MAD portion of the Phase 1/2a clinical trial are expected in the first half of 2027.
Building on previously reported interim results from the ACCESS OLE at 56 weeks in March 2026, aleniglipron demonstrated continued weight reduction at 72 weeks.
The Company expects topline data in the second half of 2028.
